cards.title: A real gap this round closed (decision 99)
items: further_submission_requests[] previously had no sign-off checkpoint — distinct from the pre-meeting supervision-question sign-off. Raised by Meeting Facilitator, resolved by Lead/Approver, same per-item accept/edit/reject pattern as every other checkpoint

Round-2 documents flow through the same automated Intake Tracker as round-1 (decision 100): each finalized request becomes a new rfi_questions[] row, firing round_submitted(2) into Sufficiency Check, not Gap Analysis's all_submitted (fixes audit 2.7)

cards.title: Diagram scope
items: Covers only the gap between draft and relay/round-2 intake. Sufficiency Check itself (a separate, later gate judging whether round-2 responses actually close the meeting's gaps) is drawn in lfi-workflow-phase2-meeting-v1.html, not repeated here
SLA duration not yet set for this checkpoint — tune empirically once real cases exist, same treatment as decisions 30/54
